name: io.github.noahowsh/yorkerapi
title: YorkerAPI
description: Cricket ball by ball in every format, men's and women's, joined to sportsbook match-winner prices.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your YorkerAPI API key. Get a free key (500 credits every month) at yorkerapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Every competition we hold with its key, format, match count and seasons

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: Team ids for international sides and franchises, men's and women's

tools.name: search_players
tools.description: Find a player's id by name, or list a team's players

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Upcoming and live matches in every competition, with both sides' ratings

tools.name: get_matches
tools.description: Results by competition, season, team, venue or date, with scores and margins

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Our Elo ratings by format, best first

tools.name: get_match
tools.description: One match in full: batting and bowling cards, ratings and every book's opening and closing price

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: A career by format: runs, average, strike rate, wickets, economy, hundreds, best figures

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: A player split by season, competition, phase (powerplay, middle, death) or format

tools.name: get_player_matches
tools.description: A player's matches with batting and bowling in each innings

tools.name: get_matchup
tools.description: A batter against a bowler: balls, runs, strike rate, dots and every dismissal

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Leaders in runs, average, strike rate, sixes, wickets, economy

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: How a ground plays: par totals, batting first against chasing, toss effect

tools.name: get_odds
tools.description: Match-winner prices by sportsbook, opening and closing, from mid-2020

tools.name: get_deliveries
tools.description: Ball-by-ball rows for a match, a batter or a bowler, with our win probability

tools.name: get_win_probability
tools.description: A match's win-probability worm over by over, and the balls that swung it

tools.name: get_market_vs_model
tools.description: In-play prices beside our win probability, lined up to the exact ball

tools.name: get_line_movement
tools.description: Every pregame snapshot by book, the market line over time, and in-play prices
